title: Private Backup/Restore Metrics + Alerts Plan (SRE/Obs) — v0.6
content:
Purpose
- Sheet-like plan for the Redwood Private Day-2 Ops toolkit observability: proposed metrics, alerts, thresholds, owners, and (placeholder) dashboard screenshots.
- Primary audiences: Private operators + Redwood SRE/Support during incidents and customer restore drills.

Scope
- Backup create/verify jobs (scheduled + ad-hoc)
- Restore jobs (in-place + to-new-cluster)
- DB PITR signals (WAL archiving where supported)
- Maintenance mode / write quiesce signals in control plane
- DR drill tracking (quarterly game days + customer pilots)

Notes / assumptions
- Metrics emitted by: rw-private-dr CLI jobs, control plane services (maintenance mode + quiesce), and Postgres helpers.
- Collection via Prometheus in Private clusters; dashboards in Grafana (observability-pack).
- Metric naming convention: redwood_private_<domain>_<name>_<unit> (snake case), with consistent labels.
- Labels (minimum standard):
  - cluster_id (string; required)
  - environment (prod|staging|dev; required)
  - deployment_mode (vpc|onprem; required)
  - backup_target (s3|minio|nfs|gcs|azure|local_bundle; optional)
  - namespace (k8s namespace; optional)
  - job_type (scheduled|manual|pre_upgrade; optional)
  - dr_tier (standard|strict; optional but recommended)
  - result (success|failure; where applicable)
  - reason (enum-ish; best-effort; keep cardinality bounded)

Noise reduction rules (apply to all alerts unless noted)
- Suppress alerts when cluster_state="paused" or cluster_state="decommissioned".
- Add a 15m “new cluster grace” window for fresh installs (cluster_age < 15m).
- Prefer alerting on “age since last successful backup” vs. raw failure counts for scheduled backups.
- For scheduled backup miss alerts: require 2 consecutive missed windows before paging.

RPO/RTO tier mapping (inputs to thresholds)
- dr_tier=standard (default if unset)
  - Recommended backup frequency: daily
  - Alert thresholds: last_successful_backup_age > 30h (warning), > 48h (page)
- dr_tier=strict
  - Recommended backup frequency: <= 1h
  - Alert thresholds: last_successful_backup_age > 2h (warning), > 4h (page)

Dashboard set (target)
- Grafana folder: “Private / Backup + Restore”
- Dashboards:
  1) Private Backup Overview (fleet + per-cluster)
  2) Private Backup Job Deep Dive (duration, bytes, errors, throttling)
  3) Private Restore Overview (restore executions + validation gates)
  4) DR Drill Tracking (quarterly game day + customer drill annotations)

Alert routing conventions
- Paging alerts -> #eng-sre-oncall (and customer-specific channel if designated)
- Ticket alerts -> Support queue + #support (with runbook link)
- All alerts include:
  - cluster_id, environment, deployment_mode, backup_target
  - last backup id / timestamp (if known)
  - link to /backup-status (incident-bot)
  - direct Confluence runbook link

TABLE: Proposed metrics + alerts + ownership (working)
Columns:
ID | Domain | Metric name | Type | Source | Labels | Target/SLO | Alert (condition) | Severity | Owner | Runbook mapping | Dashboard panel | Screenshot needed | Notes

M-01 | backup | redwood_private_backup_last_successful_timestamp_seconds | gauge | rw-private-dr / backup create | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode,backup_target,job_type,dr_tier | n/a | A-01 based on age | n/a | Observability (Sergio) | n/a | Backup Overview: “Last successful backup age” | yes | Prefer storing timestamp as seconds since epoch.
M-02 | backup | redwood_private_backup_create_total | counter | rw-private-dr / backup create | +result,+reason | n/a | A-02 high failure rate OR consecutive failures | n/a | Eng Private (Ethan) | Confluence: runbook-private-backup-create-and-verify | Backup Overview: “Backups (success/fail) over time” | yes | reason examples: access_denied, kms_denied, upload_timeout, db_lock, checksum_mismatch.
M-03 | backup | redwood_private_backup_create_duration_seconds | histogram | rw-private-dr / backup create | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode,backup_target,job_type | P95 under configured timeout window | A-04 duration p95 regression | ticket | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: private-backup-failure-troubleshooting | Backup Deep Dive: “Duration p50/p90/p99” | yes | Configure bucket boundaries around 30s/1m/5m/15m/30m/60m/120m.
M-04 | backup | redwood_private_backup_bytes_total | counter | rw-private-dr / backup create | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode,backup_target | n/a | A-05 anomalous bytes (0 or sudden spike) | ticket | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: private-backup-failure-troubleshooting | Backup Deep Dive: “Backup size trend” | yes | Used to detect partial backups or runaway logs.
M-05 | backup | redwood_private_backup_checksum_verify_total | counter | rw-private-dr / backup verify | +result,+reason | n/a | A-06 verify failure | page (strict) / ticket (standard) | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: runbook-private-backup-create-and-verify | Backup Overview: “Verify pass rate” | yes | Verify should run automatically after create for scheduled jobs.
M-06 | backup | redwood_private_backup_prune_total | counter | rw-private-dr / retention prune | +result,+reason | n/a | A-07 prune misbehavior signals | ticket | Eng Private (Ethan) | Confluence: private-backup-failure-troubleshooting | Backup Deep Dive: “Prune activity” | no | reason should include safety_guard_latest_protected.
M-07 | backup | redwood_private_backup_upload_inflight | gauge | rw-private-dr / backup create | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode,backup_target | n/a | A-08 stuck upload | ticket | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: private-backup-failure-troubleshooting | Backup Deep Dive: “Uploads in-flight” | no | Helpful for “backup stuck for 2h” reports.

M-08 | storage | redwood_private_backup_storage_errors_total | counter | storage adapter | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode,backup_target,operation,+reason | n/a | A-03 AccessDenied / KMSDenied immediate page (prod) | page | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: private-backup-failure-troubleshooting | Backup Deep Dive: “Storage errors by reason” | yes | operation: list|put|get|multipart_complete.
M-09 | storage | redwood_private_backup_storage_throttle_seconds_total | counter | storage adapter | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode,backup_target | n/a | A-04 duration correlates; only ticket | ticket | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: private-backup-failure-troubleshooting | Backup Deep Dive: “Throttle time” | no | For S3 slowdowns / minio backpressure.

M-10 | postgres | redwood_private_pg_dump_total | counter | pg helper | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode,+result,+reason | n/a | A-09 pg_dump failure | page (prod) | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: private-backup-failure-troubleshooting | Backup Deep Dive: “DB dump success/fail” | yes | Ensure reason doesn’t include raw SQL errors with sensitive data.
M-11 | postgres | redwood_private_pg_dump_duration_seconds | histogram | pg helper | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode | P95 < backup timeout | A-04 duration | ticket | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: private-backup-failure-troubleshooting | Backup Deep Dive: “DB dump duration” | no | Useful when lock contention inflates runtime.
M-12 | postgres | redwood_private_wal_archive_lag_seconds | gauge | PITR helper | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode | strict tier: < 10m typical | A-10 WAL archiving stalled/lagging | page (strict) / ticket (standard) | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: private-backup-failure-troubleshooting | Backup Deep Dive: “WAL lag” | yes | Only present where PITR configured.

M-14 | maintenance | redwood_private_write_quiesce_duration_seconds | histogram | control plane + DB layer | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode | n/a | A-12 quiesce never achieved | page during restore | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: runbook-private-restore-in-place | Restore Overview: “Quiesce achieved?” | no | Emitted during restore flows; helps debug restore plan failures.

M-15 | restore | redwood_private_restore_execute_total | counter | rw-private-dr / restore execute | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode,restore_type,+result,+reason | n/a | A-13 restore failed | page (customer drill/prod), ticket (staging) | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: runbook-private-restore-in-place; runbook-private-restore-to-new-cluster | Restore Overview: “Restore attempts” | yes | restore_type=in_place|new_cluster.
M-16 | restore | redwood_private_restore_duration_seconds | histogram | rw-private-dr / restore execute | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode,restore_type | RTO target tracked separately | A-14 restore duration > maintenance window | page (if active incident) | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: runbook-private-restore-in-place | Restore Overview: “Restore duration p95” | yes | Record “start” at operator confirmation; record “end” at validation pass.

M-19 | drills | redwood_private_drill_rto_seconds | gauge | drill template export (manual entry v0) | cluster_id,environment,deployment_mode,scenario | meet target | A-17 RTO miss | ticket | SRE (Rafael) | Confluence: private-dr-game-days-2025 | DR Drill Tracking: “RTO actual vs target” | yes | scenario examples: lost_db, lost_cluster, lost_bucket.

ALERTS: Definitions (working)
A-01 BackupTooOld
- Input: redwood_private_backup_last_successful_timestamp_seconds
- Expr: (time() - last_successful_ts) > threshold_by_dr_tier
- Thresholds:
  - standard: warn 30h, page 48h
  - strict: warn 2h, page 4h
- Owner: SRE (Rafael)
- Runbook: Confluence private-backup-failure-troubleshooting + incident-bot /backup-status

A-02 BackupCreateFailuresConsecutive
- Input: redwood_private_backup_create_total{result="failure"}
- Expr: increase(failures[2h]) >= 2 AND no success in same window
- Severity: ticket (standard), page (strict) when in prod
- Owner: SRE
- Notes: prefer “consecutive” logic to avoid flapping during transient throttling.

A-03 StorageAccessDeniedOrKMSDenied
- Input: redwood_private_backup_storage_errors_total{reason=~"access_denied|kms_denied"}
- Expr: increase(errors[15m]) > 0
- Severity: page (prod)
- Owner: SRE
- Runbook: Confluence private-backup-failure-troubleshooting (section: IAM/KMS)

A-04 BackupDurationRegression
- Input: redwood_private_backup_create_duration_seconds
- Expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(duration_bucket[6h])) > configured_backup_timeout*0.8
- Severity: ticket
- Owner: SRE
- Notes: tie to backup window scheduling guidance (avoid peak usage).

A-05 BackupBytesAnomaly
- Input: redwood_private_backup_bytes_total
- Expr: increase(bytes[24h]) == 0 OR increase(bytes[24h]) > 3x rolling baseline
- Severity: ticket
- Owner: SRE
- Notes: baseline per cluster; keep simple initially (0 bytes is strongest signal).

A-06 BackupVerifyFailed
- Input: redwood_private_backup_checksum_verify_total{result="failure"}
- Expr: increase(failures[24h]) > 0
- Severity: page (strict tier prod), ticket otherwise
- Owner: SRE

A-07 RetentionPruneSafetyGuardTriggered
- Input: redwood_private_backup_prune_total{reason="safety_guard_latest_protected"}
- Expr: increase(count[24h]) > 0
- Severity: ticket
- Owner: Eng Private
- Notes: indicates operator misconfig or retention too aggressive.

A-08 BackupUploadStuck
- Input: redwood_private_backup_upload_inflight
- Expr: max_over_time(inflight[2h]) > 0
- Severity: ticket
- Owner: SRE

A-09 PgDumpFailed
- Input: redwood_private_pg_dump_total{result="failure"}
- Expr: increase(failures[1h]) > 0
- Severity: page (prod)
- Owner: SRE

A-10 WALArchiveLagHigh
- Input: redwood_private_wal_archive_lag_seconds
- Expr: lag > 600 (strict warn) / lag > 1800 (strict page)
- Severity: warn/page by tier
- Owner: SRE

A-11 MaintenanceModeStuck
- Input: redwood_private_maintenance_mode_state
- Expr: maintenance_mode==1 for > 2h (or configured maintenance window)
- Severity: ticket; page only if active customer incident
- Owner: Eng Platform + SRE

A-12 QuiesceNotAchieved
- Input: redwood_private_write_quiesce_duration_seconds OR restore gate events
- Expr: restore in progress AND no successful quiesce gate within 15m
- Severity: page (during restore)
- Owner: SRE

A-13 RestoreFailed
- Input: redwood_private_restore_execute_total{result="failure"}
- Expr: increase(failures[1h]) > 0
- Severity: page (prod / drill window)
- Owner: SRE
- Runbook: restore-in-place / restore-to-new-cluster + incident-bot /restore-checklist

A-14 RestoreDurationExceeded
- Input: redwood_private_restore_duration_seconds
- Expr: p95 > maintenance_window_seconds
- Severity: ticket (post-mortem action)
- Owner: SRE

A-15 RestoreValidationGateFailures
- Input: redwood_private_restore_validation_gate_total{result="failure"}
- Expr: increase(failures[30m]) > 0 AND restore in progress
- Severity: page
- Owner: Eng Private + SRE

A-16 DRDrillOverdue
- Input: redwood_private_drill_last_successful_timestamp_seconds
- Expr: time() - last_drill_ts > 90d
- Severity: ticket
- Owner: SRE

A-17 DRDrillRTOMissed
- Input: redwood_private_drill_rto_seconds
- Expr: rto_actual > rto_target_by_tier
- Severity: ticket
- Owner: SRE

Runbook mapping (canonical links to embed in alerts)
- Backup create/verify: Confluence → eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/runbook-private-backup-create-and-verify
- Restore (in-place): Confluence → eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/runbook-private-restore-in-place
- Restore (new cluster): Confluence → eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/runbook-private-restore-to-new-cluster
- SRE troubleshooting: Confluence → eng-sre/runbooks/private-backup-failure-troubleshooting
- Upgrade gate (backup-before-upgrade): Confluence → eng-private-deployments/upgrade-and-rollback/backup-before-upgrade-policy
- Incident bot shortcuts:
  - /backup-status (links dashboards + last success)
  - /restore-checklist (links restore runbook + validation gates)

Screenshot placeholders (to fill once dashboards are stable)
- [ ] Backup Overview dashboard: panel “Last successful backup age (table)”
- [ ] Backup Overview: panel “Backups success/failure by cluster (stacked)”
- [ ] Backup Deep Dive: panel “Duration percentiles”
- [ ] Backup Deep Dive: panel “Storage errors by reason”
- [ ] Restore Overview: panel “Validation gates timeline”
- [ ] DR Drill Tracking: panel “RTO actual vs target”

Open questions / TODOs
- Do we want a single fleet-level objective (SLO toolkit) per cluster: backup_success_rate >= 99% over 30d? (See slo-toolkit/pr_91)
- Confirm cardinality constraints for reason labels (keep bounded, define enum list in code).
- Finalize alert routing for customer-owned on-call vs Redwood on-call during pilots (Markus Klein to confirm expectations).
- Decide whether drill RTO metrics stay manual (template export) vs add a lightweight “drill annotator” job.

Change log
- 2025-12-15: Added dr_tier threshold mapping + restore gate metrics; aligned alert names with observability-pack conventions; added suppression rules for paused clusters.
- 2025-11-03: Initial draft table from ENG-4869 planning + PRs 229/237.
